name: bothReturnTypesAndParametersEqual
input: this ArrowType with returnType A and param [type A], that ArrowType with returnType A and param [type A], EquivalenceMethod.IDENTITY
expected: Returns true because return types are equivalent and parameters match perfectly.

name: returnTypesNotEqual
input: this ArrowType with returnType A, that ArrowType with returnType B, same parameters, EquivalenceMethod.IDENTITY
expected: Returns false because returnType.checkEquivalenceHelper returns false early.

name: bothParameterListsEmpty
input: this ArrowType with empty parameters node, that ArrowType with empty parameters node, EquivalenceMethod.IDENTITY
expected: Returns true because bothParam == otherParam evaluates to true when both are null.

name: thisHasParamWithNullTypeOtherHasParamWithNonNullType
input: this ArrowType with param node having null JSType, that ArrowType with param node having non-null JSType, EquivalenceMethod.IDENTITY
expected: Returns false because thisParamType is null while otherParamType is not null.

name: thisHasParamWithNonNullTypeOtherHasParamWithNullType
input: this ArrowType with param node having non-null JSType, that ArrowType with param node having null JSType, EquivalenceMethod.IDENTITY
expected: Returns false because thisParamType != null, but otherParamType is null, failing equivalence check.

name: bothParamsNonNullButEquivalenceFails
input: this ArrowType with param type A, that ArrowType with param type B (non-equivalent), EquivalenceMethod.IDENTITY
expected: Returns false because thisParamType.checkEquivalenceHelper returns false.

name: bothParamsNonNullAndEquivalenceSucceeds
input: this ArrowType with param type A, that ArrowType with equivalent param type A, EquivalenceMethod.IDENTITY
expected: Returns true because checkEquivalenceHelper returns true for the parameters.

name: differentParameterListLengthsThisLonger
input: this ArrowType with two parameters, that ArrowType with one parameter, EquivalenceMethod.IDENTITY
expected: Returns false because after looping, thisParam != otherParam (one is non-null, one is null).

name: differentParameterListLengthsThatLonger
input: this ArrowType with one parameter, that ArrowType with two parameters, EquivalenceMethod.IDENTITY
expected: Returns false because after looping, thisParam != otherParam (thisParam is null, otherParam is non-null).

name: multipleParametersAllMatch
input: this ArrowType with params [type A, type B], that ArrowType with params [type A, type B], EquivalenceMethod.IDENTITY
expected: Returns true because all parameter pairs match and lists terminate at the same time.

name: multipleParametersMismatchOnSecond
input: this ArrowType with params [type A, type B], that ArrowType with params [type A, type C], EquivalenceMethod.IDENTITY
expected: Returns false because the second parameter fails the equivalence check.

name: returnTypesEqualButParametersDiffer
input: this ArrowType with returnType A and param A, that ArrowType with returnType A and param B, EquivalenceMethod.IDENTITY
expected: Returns false because while return types match, hasEqualParameters returns false.
